### [`sfx_sample_attack`](../../../src/sfx_samples_f979.asm#L6) `$F979-$FCD3`

Sample 2, $f979-$fcd3 (859 bytes, about 0.36 s): the start of an attack move ($2b54).

<a id="sfx_sample_attack_cut"></a>
### [`sfx_sample_attack_cut`](../../../src/sfx_samples_f979.asm#L116) `$FCD4-$FED2`

*data*

Unused: 511 bytes of sample data between the end of sample 2 and the start of sample 3. No run reads them. They continue sample 2 with the same values ($1a-$35); sample 3 starts with other values at $fed3. Entry 2 ends at offset $0793 and entry 3 starts at $0993: the high bytes differ by 2. Sample 2 was cut by $200 bytes, about 0.18 s, after the samples were placed.
